section.div: DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 求 Star 收藏 ⭐ 如要二开，请查看署名要求部分

An agent skill that finds where a photo was taken — OpenStreetMap geometry, elevation skylines, satellite imagery and street view — and shows its work. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot.
YouTube and YouTube Music in a single app. No ads, plays in the background.
An alternative frontend for YouTube, for Android.
Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
🛰️ Track token usage across AI coding agents from your terminal. 🏅 Global leaderboard with trillions of tokens tracked.
